event_questions.label: E1
event_questions.not_this: Items merely missing where no trace, witness or circumstance points to a theft (that is open, not true); items lost, misplaced or misappropriated; a theft away from the insured location (the other claim type, Ziff. 24.2, or outside both types).
event_questions.question: Does the file state that household contents at the insured location (the Versicherungsort of the policy) were stolen or damaged by a burglary, a robbery or a simple theft (including vandalism), even if nothing was taken?

questions.label: Q1
questions.not_this: Only some vouchers cannot be obtained (then the others are still needed); the vouchers have not been attached yet or not been looked for; finding them is merely inconvenient.
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.not_this: A theft at the insured location (the other claim type, Ziff. 23.3); a burglary or robbery away from home (outside both types); items lost, left behind or misplaced. Breaking into a vehicle is not a burglary (a vehicle is not a container), and pickpocketing or trick theft is not a robbery: both are simple thefts.
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

questions.label: Q3
questions.not_this: Measures already carried out; the notification of the claim itself; steps only to find the thief. Steps still to be taken to get the stolen items back or to stop them being used or sold do reduce the loss and are not excluded.
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.not_this: Traces that exist and are left as they were, or were only photographed; the police examining the scene; traces changed by the thief or by events outside the policyholder's control.
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

questions.label: Q5
questions.not_this: The claimant simply acted quickly or found it convenient, without a danger of further loss before the insurer could be asked.
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.not_this: A motor scooter or motorcycle; bicycle parts or accessories alone. A stated e-bike leaves the fact open: the form's word 'Fahrrad' does not decide it.
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q7
questions.not_this: Another supplementary cover being missing. The claimant's narrative will rarely settle this; the policy does (insurance_policy).
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

routing.question: Which claim is this: theft or theft-related damage at the insured location (theft_at_home), a simple theft away from it (simple_theft_away), or anything else (other)? (Not this: A burglary or robbery away from the insured location (covered, if at all, by the basic cover during travel, Ziff. 26 lit. b) and any other peril: other. Neither type applies to them. Breaking into a vehicle is not a burglary (a vehicle is not a container), and pickpocketing or trick theft is not a robbery: a theft from a vehicle broken into, and pickpocketing or trick theft, away from the insured location are simple thefts away (simple_theft_away). Whether the policy includes the supplementary insurance for simple theft away, and whether an exclusion applies (for example a thief who lives in the policyholder's household), is decided within the claim type, not by this question.)

text:
Sehr geehrte Frau Bucher

Sie haben mich am Telefon nach den Kaufbelegen gefragt. Die habe ich zum Glück alle noch: für das Handy, die Kamera und die Uhr liegen die Originalquittungen bei mir im Ordner, ich habe nach dem Kauf immer alles abgelegt.

Ich möchte Ihnen aber auch nochmals schildern, was genau passiert ist, weil am Telefon ein Missverständnis entstanden ist. Mir wurde nichts einfach so gestohlen, ich wurde überfallen. Am Freitag, 10. Juli 2026, kurz vor elf Uhr abends, war ich in St. Gallen auf dem Weg vom Restaurant zum Bahnhof. In einer Unterführung kam ein Mann von hinten, hat mich gegen die Wand gestossen und mir gedroht, er schlage zu, wenn ich mich wehre. Dann hat er mir die Umhängetasche vom Arm gerissen und ist davongerannt. Ich hatte danach Schürfungen am Arm und war ziemlich durcheinander. In der Tasche waren das Handy, die Kamera, die Uhr, die ich abgenommen hatte, und mein Portemonnaie, zusammen gut CHF 8'150.

Nach dem Überfall gab es nichts, was ich sofort und ohne Rücksprache mit Ihnen hätte tun müssen. Ich habe am nächsten Tag in aller Ruhe mit Ihnen telefoniert, und es war auch gar nicht dringend.

Ein Velo war nicht dabei, ich war an dem Abend zu Fuss unterwegs.

Ich hoffe, das klärt die Sache. Es beschäftigt mich immer noch, und ich wäre froh, wenn wenigstens das Finanzielle bald geregelt wäre.

Freundliche Grüsse
Walter Bachmann
Talstrasse 93, Herisau
